outcome: A translated string can carry a user's name without the name changing how it renders.

acceptance_criteria.text: A translated string is looked up for the locale and falls back to English.

expected_verification.assertion: a German key returns German and a missing key falls back

acceptance_criteria.text: A value interpolated into a translated string cannot alter the markup of the rendered result.

expected_verification.assertion: a display name containing angle brackets renders as text rather than as markup

security_impact: An unescaped interpolation into a string rendered as HTML is stored cross-site scripting, reachable through any field a user controls.
